input: Search the web for "youth enrichment" summer programs for kids and teens in northeast Tennessee near the NC line (Johnson City, Erwin, Greeneville, Newport). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: youth enrichment summer programs Johnson City TN 2026

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 Renaissance Child camps for grades 1–6; also lists a high-school Applied STEM summer institute.

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer camp lineup includes full-day Jump Start JC, June 1–July 31.

candidates.name: Coalition for Kids
candidates.note: Free, grant-funded 2026 summer program at its Susannah Street main campus.

candidates.name: Providence Academy
candidates.note: 2026 community-open weekly athletics, fine arts and discovery camps, with full-day options.

candidates.name: Camp Greene Tennessee
candidates.note: 2026 residential summer camps for grades 2–5, middle-school students and high-school students.

candidates.name: Greeneville City Schools
candidates.note: Published a Summer Learning Camp announcement in spring 2026.

candidates.name: Greene County Schools
candidates.note: Summer Extended School Program for ages 4–14 at Doak, Mosheim and South Greene school sites.

candidates.name: Greene County YMCA
candidates.note: Official site lists supervised summer day camp; the page does not specify a season year.

candidates.name: Unicoi County Family YMCA
candidates.note: Runs summer camp and youth childcare; specific 2027 camp dates were not found.

candidates.name: East Tennessee Cheer and Gymnastics
candidates.note: Official site links summer camps and identifies a Johnson City gym; season dates were not found.
